# Oli — AI Agronomist for Greek Farmers
# https://codex-ask-oli-app.vercel.app

## What is Oli?
Oli is an AI-powered agronomist web application designed specifically for Greek farmers. It works with every crop — olives, vines, citrus, vegetables, fruit trees, herbs, and more. It provides instant crop disease diagnosis from photos, personalized treatment recommendations (both organic and chemical), and a 13-day follow-up system to track intervention outcomes.

## Key Capabilities
- **Photo Diagnosis**: Upload a photo of a sick plant and get an instant AI diagnosis identifying the disease, pest, or nutrient deficiency
- **Treatment Plans**: Every diagnosis includes both organic and chemical treatment options with exact product names, dosages, and application methods
- **VIO Loop (Verified Intervention Outcome)**: After logging a treatment, Oli follows up in 13 days to ask if the treatment worked, building a data flywheel
- **Voice Input**: Speak to Oli in Greek or English — ideal for farmers with dirty hands in the field
- **Intervention History**: Complete log of all diagnoses and treatments, searchable and exportable
- **Every Crop**: Works with every crop Greek farmers grow — olives, vines, citrus, tomatoes, peppers, cucumbers, potatoes, stone fruits, herbs, and 450+ identifiable diseases

## Supported Crops
Mediterranean crops including: olive trees (ελιά), vineyards (αμπέλι), citrus (εσπεριδοειδή — lemon, orange, mandarin), tomatoes (ντομάτα), peppers (πιπεριά), cucumbers, zucchini, eggplant, fig trees, pomegranate, almond, walnut, avocado, kiwi, strawberry, lettuce, herbs, and more.

## Common Diseases Identified
- Olive: Cycloconium (κυκλοκόνιο), olive fly (δάκος), peacock spot, verticillium wilt
- Vine: Downy mildew (περονόσπορος), powdery mildew (ωίδιο), botrytis
- Citrus: Citrus canker, sooty mold, scale insects, tristeza
- Tomato: Late blight, early blight, fusarium wilt, blossom end rot
- General: Aphids, spider mites, whitefly, nitrogen/phosphorus/potassium deficiency

## Languages
Greek (Ελληνικά) and English

## Pricing
- Free: 20 questions per month, no credit card required
- Pro: Unlimited questions (subscription)

## Technology
- AI: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash with structured JSON responses
- Stack: React, Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage), Vercel
- Data: EU-hosted (Frankfurt), GDPR compliant, end-to-end encrypted
